setup: Simulation on the real CTU-13 scenario-1 communication graph (607,511 nodes, 737,700 edges): 60 trials per class; 3-10 random busy internal background hosts as 'bots'; centralized = all bots add edges to one new external C&C IP; p2p = each bot adds 60-150 edges to a pool of 400 new peers and edges to half of the other bots; none = no injection (real traffic only).

v1_no_population_baseline.failure: destinations shared by most suspects (campus DNS resolver, popular web services) were counted as C&C controllers, so any group of hosts looked centralized

v2_population_baseline.change: only destinations contacted by <= 5% of the other active internal sources count as evidence (controllers / shared peers)
